comment: Pinned contract for the layout/hbt-probe vendor-fixture witness (issue #150).
pins.* is the tool/deck provenance the probe requires; a drift is a hard failure.
The pinned klt build (commit b15edf5e3a2e) was TESTED against klayout 0.30.10 and
warns on every run that the resolved engine (0.30.12, the version pinned here and
used by layout CI) differs. That disclosure is preserved deliberately: the probe
pins the engine actually used and records it in every raw report and summary.

extraction_recognition_gap.claim: The sg13g2 curated extraction deck declares no bipolar device class, so the three vendor npn13G2 HBT instances are not recognized (extract: 0 devices) and LVS then cannot match them (0/3/0). This fixture witnesses the aggregate recognition gap only.

not_reproduced.2AMLogic/klayout-tools#2688: DRC behavior; this npn13G2 fixture is DRC-clean under the curated deck and no expected false positives are asserted here.
not_reproduced.2AMLogic/klayout-tools#2952: X-call false green; NOT established by this probe. The attempted transformed reference in subckt-call form errors with 'reference netlist has no top circuit' on the pinned build, and this probe treats that error as a hard failure, never as a known gap.
